_comment: PUBLIC DATA ONLY. Compact municipality and place lookup supporting the Capital Markets geography classifier. Contains no private, competitor, ownership, recipient or operational information.
_sources: U.S. Census Bureau 2020 county-subdivision relationship files (codes2020/cousub/) - townships, boroughs and towns with their county.
U.S. Census Bureau 2020 place-to-county relationship files (codes2020/place/) - incorporated places and CDPs with their county.
U.S. Census Bureau 2026 Gazetteer (cousubs and places) - internal-point latitude and longitude.

_schema.counties: county names, referenced by index; "County"/"Parish" suffix removed

class.d: county division or other statistical area

_schema.notes: Class ranks a name when two municipalities in one state share it: Reading city (Berks) outranks Reading township (Adams). Where two municipalities in the SAME county share a name, the higher-ranked class keeps the bare name (Lancaster city -> "Lancaster") and the other keeps its full Census name ("Lancaster township"), so both stay reachable. lat/lon are Census internal points rounded to 4dp, null when the Gazetteer has no matching record. A place spanning counties carries an array of county indices.

places: William Paterson University of New Jersey
